**Green. 625 pass, 0 fail, 0.09s.**

Only 3 cases were ever broken, all in `order totals`.

`orderTotal` took the discount off, but then figured tax on the full price. Tax now goes on the discounted amount, which is what the comment above it already promised.

Most rows had a zero discount or a zero tax, so they passed either way. Only the three rows with both showed it.
